title: Privacy-Preserving Detection of Rare Disease-Associated Cell Subsets via Secure Multi-Party Computation
abstract: arXiv:2608.20118v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The detection of rare disease-associated cell subsets from high-dimensional single-cell measurements is critical for understanding diseases such as leukaemia and viral infections. CellCnn, a convolutional neural network (CNN) designed for this task, has demonstrated the ability to identify phenotype-associated cell populations at frequencies as low as 0.01\%. Training such models reliably requires patient cohorts that are larger and more diverse than any single institution can typically assemble, and the underlying single-cell data is too sensitive to share across institutional boundaries under existing privacy regulations. We propose a secure multi-party computation (MPC) framework that enables the training and inference of CellCnn entirely on secret-shared data. This ensures that neither the participants nor the computing servers ever observe raw patient data or intermediate values. Evaluated on benchmark single-cell datasets for cyt

translated_title: 基于安全多方计算的隐私保护稀有疾病相关细胞亚群检测
translated_abstract: 从高维单细胞测量数据中检测稀有疾病相关细胞亚群，对于理解白血病和病毒感染等疾病至关重要。CellCnn是一种为此任务设计的卷积神经网络（CNN），已被证明能够识别频率低至0.01%的表型相关细胞群。然而，可靠地训练此类模型需要比任何单一机构通常所能汇集的更大、更多样化的患者队列，而底层的单细胞数据过于敏感，在现有隐私法规下无法跨机构边界共享。我们提出了一个安全多方计算（MPC）框架，能够在完全秘密共享的数据上进行CellCnn的训练和推理。这确保了无论是参与方还是计算服务器，都永远不会观察到原始患者数据或中间值。该框架在基准单细胞数据集上进行了评估……
tldr: 提出了一种安全多方计算框架，可在秘密共享数据上完成CellCnn的训练与推理，使各机构能够在不泄露患者敏感单细胞数据的前提下协作检测稀有疾病相关细胞亚群。
en_tdlr: Proposes a secure multi-party computation framework that enables training and inference of CellCnn entirely on secret-shared data, allowing cross-institutional detection of rare disease-associated cell subsets without exposing sensitive patient single-cell data.
